_meta.description: Blip is a featherlight, open-source system monitor for your Mac's menu bar, now on iPhone and iPad. Live vitals, Blip Bench, graded speed tests and traceroute with a map. Free.
_title: Blip — System Stats for Mac, iPhone and iPad
a-blip-bench-result.edd4fe: A Blip Bench result on iPad, with the score for each category
a-featherlight-system-monitor.576728: A featherlight system monitor for your Mac's menu bar, now on iPhone and iPad too. Free, open source and tiny.
a-live-demo-click.a2f560: A live demo. Click the menu bar.
a-mac-with-apple.8d5a83: A Mac with Apple silicon on macOS 14 Sonoma or later, or an iPhone or iPad on iOS 17 or later.
a-network-speed-test.7f3679: A network speed test on iPad, with download and upload curves and grades
a-traceroute-on-ipad.aa676f: A traceroute on iPad, its hops drawn on a map
blip-bench-measures-cpu.5a1a6b: Blip Bench measures CPU, memory, GPU and Neural Engine in fixed units, so your Mac, iPhone and iPad land on one scale. A sustained run shows how much heat takes back.
blip-is-built-exclusively.784fc9: Blip is built exclusively for Apple Silicon (M1, M2, M3, M4 and newer). It uses ARM64-specific optimizations and Apple Silicon IOKit interfaces for GPU and thermal monitoring.
blip-is-free-no.661bdc: Blip is free — no ads, no tracking, no subscription. If it earns a place on your Mac, you can help fund what comes next.
built-by-blaine-miller.9d6375: Built by Blaine Miller · Open Source under MIT License
can-i-install-it.9ac23d: Can I install it with Homebrew?
does-blip-work-on.0c1c57: Does Blip work on Intel Macs?
download-and-upload-draw.fc6945: Download and upload draw as separate curves, latency is measured idle and under load, and every result is graded for calls, streaming and gaming.
follow-the-route-hop.527e29: Follow the route, hop by hop
is-blip-available-in.3bdff6: Is Blip available in the European Union?
know-what-your-connection.9e9fc6: Know what your connection can really do
most-system-monitors-use.88a179: Most system monitors use hundreds of megabytes of memory. Blip uses about 42.
no-ads-no-tracking.5e6baf: No ads. No tracking. No catch.
ping-and-traceroute-draw.4789fb: Ping and traceroute draw your route on an offline map. The location database downloads once, and lookups never leave your device.
system-is-running-within.771232: System is running within normal thermal limits.
the-app-store-keeps.416fd4: The App Store keeps Mac apps in a sandbox, so fans, temperatures, GPU, disk I/O, battery health and top processes come through the free Blip Helper. The direct download reads them itself.
what-do-i-need.c6c81a: What do I need to run it?
why-do-some-mac.0e11f5: Why do some Mac stats need Blip Helper?
yes-blip-is-on.991f87: Yes. Blip is on the App Store everywhere in the European Union, France included, and the direct download and Homebrew cask work everywhere.
yes-blip-is-open.45f52c: Yes. Blip is open source and every Mac release is notarized by Apple. There are no analytics, no crash reporters and no servers: everything runs on your device.
yes-brew-install-cask.730725: Yes: brew install --cask blaineam/tap/blip installs the direct-download Mac app.
yes-on-every-platform.f595c8: Yes, on every platform. The App Store app for Mac, iPhone and iPad, the direct download and the Homebrew cask are all free, with nothing to unlock.
your-devices-vitals-at.cb380c: Your devices' vitals, at a glance.
